title: Oracle PL/SQL Department Bonus Audit
retrieval_summary: Oracle PL/SQL procedure utilizing explicit cursor and NVL/ROUND functions to compute aggregate department bonus with NO_DATA_FOUND exception handler.
scenario: An enterprise financial audit on Oracle Database 19c requires a stored procedure to compute the total bonus pool allocated to a specific department. If the department has no active staff, handle the exception gracefully and return 0.
query_instructions: Implement the PL/SQL procedure calculate_dept_bonus that calculates 10% bonus across the department staff and returns the total bonus in an OUT parameter p_total_bonus.
explanation: Total salary for department 50 is 17000 + 17000 = 34000. At 10%, the computed total bonus is 3400.00.
